items.stem: In Meta's campaign hierarchy, audience targeting and budget are set primarily at which level?

options.rationale: The ad level holds creative, not core targeting and budget.
Correct: the ad set controls audience, placement and (in ABO) budget.
The account holds settings and billing, not per-audience targeting.
The pixel is a measurement tool, not a campaign hierarchy level.

items.explanation: Correct: the ad set controls audience, placement and (in ABO) budget.

items.stem: Why should you avoid judging an ad set's performance during the learning phase?

options.text: Results are hidden until learning ends
options.rationale: Data is visible; it is just not yet stable.

options.text: Delivery is still stabilising, so early metrics are unreliable
options.rationale: Correct: performance is volatile during learning and should not drive premature decisions.

options.text: The learning phase disables the pixel
options.rationale: The pixel keeps working during learning.

options.text: Budgets cannot be changed during learning
options.rationale: Budgets can change; doing so can actually reset learning.

items.explanation: Correct: performance is volatile during learning and should not drive premature decisions.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about the Meta pixel and Conversions API are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: The Conversions API can send events server-side to complement the browser pixel
options.rationale: Correct: CAPI sends server-side events, improving resilience to browser limits.

options.text: Privacy and browser changes have reduced the reliability of pixel-only tracking
options.rationale: Correct: signal loss from privacy changes is a key reason to add CAPI.

options.text: The pixel measures only offline, in-store sales
options.rationale: The pixel measures on-site web events, not only offline sales.

options.text: Conversions API makes attribution perfectly exact
options.rationale: CAPI improves but does not make attribution perfectly exact.

items.explanation: Correct: CAPI sends server-side events, improving resilience to browser limits.; Correct: signal loss from privacy changes is a key reason to add CAPI.
